use IO.Std
use default

// The rooms of a dodecahedron: twenty of them, each
// joined to three others.
let caves = [
    [2, 5, 8],    [1, 3, 10],   [2, 4, 12],   [3, 5, 14],
    [1, 4, 6],    [5, 7, 15],   [6, 8, 17],   [1, 7, 9],
    [8, 10, 18],  [2, 9, 11],   [10, 12, 19], [3, 11, 13],
    [12, 14, 20], [4, 13, 15],  [6, 14, 16],  [15, 17, 20],
    [7, 16, 18],  [9, 17, 19],  [11, 18, 20], [13, 16, 19]
]

let random = System.Random(20260908)

let taken = LIST[int]()

fresh_room() -> int =>
    (let chosen mut = random.next(caves.count) + 1

     while taken.contains(chosen) do
         chosen = random.next(caves.count) + 1
     od

     taken.add(chosen)

     chosen)

let wumpus mut = fresh_room()
let bats = [fresh_room(), fresh_room()] |> collect_list()
let pits = [fresh_room(), fresh_room()] |> collect_list()

let player mut = fresh_room()

let arrows mut = 5

tunnels(room: int) -> LIST[int] => caves[room - 1] |> collect_list()

deadly(room: int) -> bool =>
    room == wumpus \/ bats.contains(room) \/ pits.contains(room)

sense() is
    for near in tunnels(player) do
        if near == wumpus then
            Std.write_line("you smell something terrible nearby")
        elif bats.contains(near) then
            Std.write_line("you hear a rustling")
        elif pits.contains(near) then
            Std.write_line("you feel a cold wind from a nearby cavern")
        fi
    od
si

// Waking, the wumpus wanders into one of the rooms next to its own.
disturb_wumpus() is
    if random.next(4) < 3 then
        let ways = tunnels(wumpus)

        wumpus = ways[random.next(ways.count)]
    fi
si

let outcome mut = ""

enter(room: int) is
    player = room

    if player == wumpus then
        outcome = "the wumpus eats you"
    elif pits.contains(player) then
        outcome = "you fall into a bottomless pit"
    elif bats.contains(player) then
        Std.write_line("a giant bat carries you off")

        let empty =
            (1::caves.count)
                |> filter(room => !deadly(room))
                |> collect_list()

        enter(empty[random.next(empty.count)])
    fi
si

Std.write_line("hunt the wumpus: m to move, s to shoot, then a room")

while outcome.length == 0 do
    Std.write_line()
    Std.write_line("you are in room {player}")

    sense()

    Std.write_line("tunnels lead to {tunnels(player) |> join(", ")}")
    Std.write("your move: ")

    let typed = Std.read_line()

    if !typed? then
        break
    fi

    let words = typed.trim().to_lower().split([' '])

    if words.count != 2 \/ !"ms".contains(words[0]) then
        Std.write_line(
            "say m or s and a room, as in m {tunnels(player)[0]}"
        )
    elif !tunnels(player).contains(int.parse(words[1])) then
        Std.write_line("no tunnel leads there")
    elif words[0] =~ "m" then
        enter(int.parse(words[1]))
    else
        arrows = arrows - 1

        if int.parse(words[1]) == wumpus then
            outcome = "your arrow finds the wumpus, you win"
        else
            Std.write_line("your arrow clatters away into the dark")

            disturb_wumpus()

            if wumpus == player then
                outcome = "the wumpus blunders into you and eats you"
            elif arrows == 0 then
                outcome =
                    "you loose your last arrow, and are defenceless"
            fi
        fi
    fi
od

Std.write_line()
Std.write_line(outcome)
